title: Unify Today and Needs you around real decisions
head: Commit containing this receipt; exact published SHA and mandatory commit checks recorded in the PR description.

dependencies.stack: User-requested F stack on corrected F-11; keep PRs open and unmerged.

baseline_review.parent_ci: Corrected F-11 head passes test, Docker, Windows, AppleScript and label checks.

source_review.comparison: Pinned work/authority/effect sources match main and the F-11 base. Existing listWorkItems(today:true) filters creation by current day; legacy Authority reads pending/restart-unresolved separately. F12 adds a shared provider without changing those legacy contracts. D07/D08 remain presentation/transition modules on their separate stack.

figma.visual: Provider and API implementation only; no UI layout change or screenshot claim.

activation.requires: Shared vault/workflow schema, existing approval manager and deferred executor. Exact flag value 1 at daemon startup.

implementation: Typed approval, commitment-work and effect references with stable canonical identities. Effect and run views resolve to the same approval; blocked work wrappers do not duplicate their effect decision.
No day filter; retain earlier unresolved work and failed/blocked/unknown receipts. Keep permission, intent acceptance, execution and verified work result distinct.
Persist numeric user placement in an additive table. Bounded keyset pages sort by placement, source time and ID; durable generation invalidates changed traversals with explicit 409 refresh.
Advertise supported actions and opaque source revisions. Reuse work/approval/recovery writers with atomic revision guards around writes only; existing dispatch claims commit before tool invocation.
Authenticated, no-store queue, run-scoped read, ID lookup, placement and resolution routes. Default-off registration and protected daemon environment inventory.

acceptance.check: Same decision identity/status across queue, run, effect detail and reload; duplicate actions cannot advance twice
acceptance.evidence: Service and authenticated HTTP tests, file-backed reopen, concurrent submissions, second-connection observation of claim before fake dispatch.

acceptance.check: Earlier unresolved work remains visible; unknown/blocked effects cannot become false success
acceptance.evidence: Three-day-old work; unknown/blocked/failed effect tests against SUCCEEDED runs and legacy verified work; unknown beyond 50 reference cap.

acceptance.check: Durable user placement and bounded stable traversal
acceptance.evidence: 205 equal-time decisions paged across database restart, no duplicate IDs; insert/reorder/legacy-write/delete invalidation and run cursor scope checks.

focused.initial_finding: Authenticated HTTP test exposed percent-encoded typed IDs retained by the daemon router. Added guarded path decoding; round trip now passes.

checks: Remove canonical revision guard: one failure
Hide uncertain effects behind verified work: three failures
mutations.restored_suite: 357 affected tests pass after restoring all mutations

verification.guards: Normal mandatory EE, migration, template, package, related tests and TypeScript commit hooks; final outcome in PR description.
verification.live_provider: not_run; temporary databases, synthetic tools and Unix socket only; no live daemon flag, provider call or external message.

limitations: Backend API/provider only. The D-track rooms must bind to the common queue and use its supportedActions; no UI activation is included.
Pagination deliberately returns queue_changed after any relevant canonical source/placement write, so busy workflows can require a new traversal.
At most 100 decisions and 50 effect references per item; aggregate effect states include every related receipt. Source inspection continues through canonical detail APIs.
Execution, blocker recovery and verified result entry remain existing workflows; the queue does not introduce effect retries or an alternative result writer.
Full repository CI is tracked separately on the PR; local evidence covers the affected suites.
rollback: Unset JARVIS_BRIEF_DECISIONS and restart. Preserve additive placement/clock metadata and all canonical approvals, work decisions and effect receipts.
